What does the parallelism field do in th.fact: The parallelism field is set to 2 in the job-wq-2 manifest.
The parallelism field means a maximum of 2 Pods run simultaneously.
Each pod picks up one unit of work from the Redis queue.
Each pod processes the work and repeats until the queue is empty.

How do you fill the Redis work queue wit.fact: Start a temporary interactive pod using the command: kubectl run -i --tty temp --image redis --command "/bin/sh"
Connect to Redis using the command: redis-cli -h redis
Push tasks using the command: rpush job2 followed by the task name
Verify the queue contents using the command: lrange job2 0 -1

What is the difference between HPA and V.fact: HPA scales the number of pod replicas up or down
HPA scaling is based on CPU or custom metrics
VPA adjusts the CPU and memory resource requests and limits for existing pods
VPA resizes the resources of existing pods

How do you install the Metrics Server fo.fact: Run kubectl apply -f https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server/releases/latest/download/components.yaml to install the Metrics Server.
Verify the installation with kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep metrics-server.

When should you use the Databricks REST.fact: Use the Databricks REST API when none of the supported SDK languages (Python, Java, Go, R) are available for your use case.
Use the Databricks REST API when you need to automate processes for which no SDK currently exists in your preferred programming language.

What are the three main developer tools.fact: Databricks CLI is one of the three main developer tools
Databricks SDKs are one of the three main developer tools
Databricks REST API is one of the three main developer tools

What are the valid restart policy values.fact: OnFailure is a valid restart policy for a Kubernetes Job pod.
Never is a valid restart policy for a Kubernetes Job pod.
The Always policy is not allowed for a Kubernetes Job pod.

What are the completions and parallelism.fact: completions specifies how many pods must successfully complete before the Job is considered done
parallelism controls the maximum number of pods that can run at the same time

Which Kubernetes API group does a Job re.fact: A Job resource belongs to the batch/v1 API group.

How do you start a local Kubernetes clus.fact: Creates a single-node Kubernetes cluster on your local machine using Docker
kubectl is automatically configured to use the minikube cluster
kubectl is automatically configured to use the default namespace

What kubectl command checks the status o.fact: Use kubectl get jobs to see the COMPLETIONS, DURATION, and AGE of all jobs.

How do you verify that the core Kubernet.fact: All listed pods should show a Running status
